question: Should Factory Auto mode prefer an available API key over an existing browser or WorkOS session when those credentials may belong to different accounts?
rationale: The implementation can safely support either ordering, but selecting the default displayed account is a user-visible provider policy that automated review cannot settle.

options.title: Prefer API key
options.body: Keep API-first Auto and document explicit `web` selection for users who want their browser account.

options.title: Preserve web precedence
options.body: Keep the existing browser or WorkOS account in Auto and require explicit `api` selection for API-key usage.

recommendation.title: Prefer API key
recommendation.body: Keep API-first Auto and document explicit `web` selection for users who want their browser account.

likelyOwner.reason: His merged history covers the Factory authentication, fallback, provider-descriptor, settings, and Linux surfaces affected by this policy.
